extraListings.note: The second Superior T0 knee pads tile opens the same card as the first, word for word.

The second Superior T0 gloves tile. Unlike the other cards, which describe how the piece is created ("This Gear will be created with 1 Bonuses and 0 random Talents"), this one is a finished Level 1 item: Power Score ---, Health 722, Armor 60, +8 to each core attribute, one Random Bonus Attribute, and the Fearless Warrior set. "Fearless" is shown in orange before the name. The Captain Cow list shows the same tile in the same place; it wasn't opened there.
